lhs: BitcastConvert packs two U4 literal bytes into one U8 result, or unpacks one U8 into two U4 result cells.
rhs: Ordinary evaluator bitcast copies the result literal byte count from the input prefix, reporting failure if input storage is too short.
conditions: Little-endian, static dense U8 scalar and U4[2] with minor-most axis 0 and explicit four-bit HLO element size, common memory space and one-byte HLO storage, layout-sensitive rewrite enabled; operand a parameter.
types: Two unsigned nibble lanes and one unsigned byte. Observations distinguish successful result bytes from an evaluation error.
overlap: Ideal packed physical split/join and same-width word reindexing are existing library results. This observation distinguishes unpacked evaluator literal backing from packed HLO size. It establishes no native backend discrepancy.
